posts.name: 23f1000883@ds.study.iitm.ac.in
posts.cooked: Sir I am very less know anything from week 5 to 8 and therefore want a suggestion on how to score good marks in this coming oppe on 16 August as it is very less time left for it

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
It’s a bit difficult score good marks if you are not well versed with the contents of week 5 to 8. I suggest go through the sessions from this sheet -

accounts.google.com

Google Sheets: Sign-in

Access Google Sheets with a personal Google account or Google Workspace account (for business use).

For now the optimal strategy is to go get your basics strong and attempt 16th August OPPE and get a flavour of it, practice well and attempt OPPE (re-attempt) on 23rd August.

Note: You will only be given a reattempt chance if you score <40 in OPPE conducted on 16th August.

The key is to practice as much as possible so that commands and syntax become second nature, making it easier to understand and use the man pages effectively.
